// Committed red-probe for the TERNARY arm of the Greek copy freeze.
// Parsed (never compiled) by tests/unit/greek-string-inventory.test.ts, which
// asserts the EXACT multiset extracted from this file — one MATCH per branch
// shape that exists in the codebase, plus the NO MATCH shapes that must stay
// out. Editing this file without updating that assertion turns the guard red,
// which is the point: the probe proves the detector detects.

declare const lang: string
declare const isEl: boolean
declare const formal: boolean
declare const score: number
declare const days: number
declare const flag: boolean
declare const stored: string | null
declare const v: number
declare function counted(n: number, one: string, many: string): string
declare function compute(n: number): string
declare function other(n: number): string

// MATCH: the canonical locale ternary — only the Greek branch freezes.
export const m1 = lang === "el" ? "Απλό κείμενο" : "Plain text"

// MATCH: alias condition — the condition is never inspected.
export const m2 = isEl ? 'Ψευδώνυμο' : 'Alias'

// MATCH: reversed polarity — the Greek sits in whenFalse.
export const m3 = lang === "en" ? "English first" : "Στα ελληνικά δεύτερο"

// MATCH: template WITH interpolation — the SHAPE is frozen.
export const m4 = isEl ? `Λήγει σε ${days} ημέρες` : `Expires in ${days} days`

// MATCH: multiline template branch — whitespace collapses to one space.
export const m5 = isEl
    ? `Πρώτη γραμμή
       δεύτερη γραμμή`
    : "one line"

// MATCH x3: chained else-if ternary — three leaf entries, never a mega-entry.
export const m6 = score >= 80 ? "Καλή τιμή" : score >= 60 ? "Μέτρια τιμή" : "Κακή τιμή"

// MATCH x2: parenthesized nested conditional branch is skipped as a branch;
// its own two branches freeze individually.
export const m7 = isEl ? (flag ? "Πρώτη επιλογή" : "Δεύτερη επιλογή") : "either"

// MATCH: a call whose arguments carry the Greek — the whole branch freezes.
export const m8 = isEl ? counted(v, "στοιχείο", "στοιχεία") : counted(v, "item", "items")

// MATCH: a ternary inside a template interpolation is still visited.
export const m9 = `${isEl ? "Ναι" : "No"} — done`

// MATCH x2: both branches Greek (register, not locale) — both freeze.
export const m10 = formal ? "Αγαπητέ πελάτη" : "Γεια σου φίλε"

// MATCH: Greek written as \u escapes — DECODED literal text is what counts.
export const m11 = isEl ? "\u0395\u03BB\u03BB\u03AC\u03B4\u03B1" : "Greece"

// MATCH: exact duplicate of m1's Greek — both copies survive as repeated
// lines, so deleting one of two identical strings still trips.
export const m12 = lang === "el" ? "Απλό κείμενο" : "Other text"

// NO MATCH: locale codes are ASCII — the discriminator is Greek TEXT, so the
// freeze never nags about language plumbing.
export const n1 = lang === "el" ? "el" : "en"
export const n2 = lang === "el" ? "el_GR" : "en_US"

// NO MATCH: a branch that IS an {el, en} pair — the inline arm froze its el
// side already (the guard cross-checks that below).
export const n3 = flag ? { el: "Ζεύγος εδώ", en: "Pair here" } : null

// NO MATCH: Greek only in the CONDITION is data comparison, not copy.
export const n4 = stored === "ναι" ? 1 : 2

// NO MATCH: Greek only in a comment — decoded literals decide, not raw source.
export const n5 = flag ? compute(v) /* ελληνικό σχόλιο */ : other(v)

// NO MATCH: Greek reaching the branch through a reference — the constant's own
// literal is a bare literal, deliberately outside this freeze (stated limit).
const greekConst = "Εκτός τριαδικού"
export const n6 = isEl ? greekConst : "en text"

// NO MATCH: ?? / || fallbacks are not ternaries — deliberately unfrozen (stated limit).
export const n7 = stored ?? "Εφεδρικό κείμενο"
export const n8 = stored || "Άλλο εφεδρικό"
